name: badminton_swing
text: A badminton player standing sideways in a balanced stance prepares an overhead forehand. Right elbow bends and racket hand goes behind the head, torso turns, right arm swings overhead forward to strike, follows through across the body, returns to ready. One controlled stroke.

runtime.note: Runtime pose and object tracks are the final interaction. Source NPZ alone does not encode those contacts or object motion.
